title: Equivariant Energy-Guided SDE for Inverse Molecular Design

layout.note: Three stacked bands: two dashed boxes side by side on top (invariance of E at left, the condition at right), a row of five molecule tiles linked by arrows in the middle with a cyan bus line dropping four guidance arrows from the Invariant Energy box, and a one-line SDE between z_T and z_0 with an under-brace at the bottom.

lesson: Show invariance by feeding the same sample before and after a transformation to the same module and writing the equality of the outputs under it; show guidance by one saturated bus line that drops an arrow on each step of the sample chain, with the governing equation under the chain and a brace naming its guidance term.
